functions.name: lock_model_identity
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION serien_internal.lock_model_identity()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin if old.kind is distinct from new.kind and exists(select 1 from public.stock_items where model_id=old.id) then raise exception 'Cannot change model kind when in inventory' using errcode='23514';end if;return new;end;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION serien_internal.touch_updated_at()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin new.updated_at=now();return new;end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION serien_internal.check_ready_consist()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin perform serien_internal.assert_ready_consist(new.id);return null;end;$function$
